summary_short.zh: Moltbot是一个开源的个人AI助手框架，让用户能在任何操作系统上运行可定制的AI助手，同时完全掌控自己的数据。其技术核心在于采用模块化的TypeScript架构，将核心逻辑与平台集成分离，开发者可以通过插件灵活扩展功能。你可以本地部署进行私密对话，通过API与现有工具集成，或利用其完善的插件系统构建自定义扩展，打造个性化的助手体验。这种设计既保障了隐私安全，又提供了高度的可定制性，适合想要探索自主可控AI助手的开发者和技术爱好者。

summaries.en: Moltbot is an open-source personal AI assistant framework that enables users to run customizable AI assistants across any operating system while maintaining full data ownership. Its technical innovation lies in a modular TypeScript architecture that separates core logic from platform integrations, allowing developers to extend functionality through plugins. You can deploy it locally for private conversations, integrate with existing tools via APIs, or build custom extensions using its well-documented plugin system to create tailored assistant experiences.

summaries.en: System Prompts Leaks is a curated collection of extracted system prompts from major AI chatbots like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini, revealing the hidden instructions that shape their behavior. It demonstrates how these foundational prompts—often invisible to users—control tone, safety filters, and response patterns, offering a practical window into prompt engineering. Researchers and developers can study these examples to understand model constraints, design better custom prompts, or test how different systems respond to identical core instructions.

summary_short.zh: Ingress-nginx是Kubernetes的入口控制器，用于管理集群内服务的外部访问，解决将外部流量路由到内部应用的难题。它基于NGINX实现高性能反向代理和负载均衡，其核心技术优势在于动态配置重载能力，可在不中断服务的情况下更新路由规则。开发者通过部署该控制器并定义Kubernetes Ingress资源来配置路由规则，典型应用场景包括在单一IP地址下通过路径路由托管多个Web应用，或实现SSL/TLS终止以保障连接安全，为云原生应用提供灵活可靠的外部访问方案。

summaries.en: Ingress-nginx is a Kubernetes ingress controller that manages external access to services within a cluster, solving the challenge of routing external traffic to appropriate internal applications. It leverages NGINX as a high-performance reverse proxy and load balancer, with its technical strength lying in the dynamic configuration reload capability that updates routing rules without service interruption. Developers can deploy it to define routing rules through Kubernetes Ingress resources, enabling practical use cases like hosting multiple web applications under a single IP address with path-based routing or implementing SSL/TLS termination for secure connections.

summaries.en: PS2Recomp is a static recompilation tool that transforms PlayStation 2 game executables into native PC ports, addressing the challenge of preserving classic games on modern hardware. It works by analyzing and translating PS2 machine code into optimized C++ equivalents, enabling direct compilation for x86 systems without emulation overhead. Developers can use it to port specific games by providing the original binaries, then modify the generated code to fix compatibility issues or add new features, offering a practical path to revive legacy titles with native performance.

summaries.en: The ext-apps project provides the official specification and TypeScript SDK for the MCP Apps protocol, which standardizes how AI chatbots can embed interactive user interfaces. Its technical innovation lies in defining a clear separation between chatbot logic and UI components through a server-client architecture, enabling developers to create reusable interface modules. You can use this SDK to build custom UI widgets that work across different MCP-compatible chatbots, or extend existing interfaces by implementing the protocol's standardized communication methods.
